scope: 24 alternating SVG/PNG activations in the final-feature release package after a warm native session.
metric_boundary: Application file activation until the existing on_next_frame callback after content acceptance; excludes OS event delivery and does not measure compositor presentation or GPU completion.
cache: Warm retained application content and filesystem caches; no flush; first SVG activation included.
hardware: Apple M4 Max, Mac16,5, 128 GiB,16 logical CPUs; macOS26.6.2/25G83 arm64
load: Other desktop processes running; builds/packaging and agents idle during these24 activations. Not a controlled-load benchmark.
limitations: RSS endpoints do not establish a long-term leak result; no baseline or speedup claim. Keyboard/drag response was observed separately and not frame-timed.
